books.title: Quantum Computing Made Clear
books.blurb: An accessible introduction to quantum computing for computer science students and beginners: qubits, quantum gates, superposition, entanglement, interference and measurement, then quantum search, factoring, optimisation and machine learning. With quantum circuit diagrams, executable Python programs, worked examples, and exercises with answers.

reviews.quote: Congratulations for your book on QC. Very well organised content, and this is what we are expecting for students: to keep it simple and clear. I will get one from Amazon.
reviews.name: Dr V Persis
reviews.role: Associate Professor, Adikavi Nannaya University, Rajahmundry
